steps.summary: On issue #5 of bench/bench-repo I opened the sidebar Labels picker, selected exactly "bug" and "priority-high", and closed the picker to commit the change (the widget posts to /bench/bench-repo/issues/labels?issue_ids=4 only when the dropdown hides — the hidden label_ids input read "1,2" before closing). The sidebar label list then rendered "bug" and "priority-high", and after a full page reload both labels are still present (sidebar shows links "bug" and "priority-high"), so the change is persisted server-side. No other labels are set. Note: clicking the options alone only ticks the picker; the update is sent when the dropdown is dismissed (Escape did not dismiss it here — clicking the picker header did).

On issue #5 of bench/bench-repo I opened the sidebar Assignees picker, clicked the option "bench-assignee
(Bench Assignee)" (data-value=3), which ticked the item and set the combo's hidden assignee_ids field to "3", then committed the change by dismissing the picker with an outside click — that hide is what makes the widget POST to /bench/bench-repo/issues/assignee?issue_ids=4. The sidebar then rendered the assignee as "bench-assignee
(Bench Assignee)" (link to /bench/bench-repo/issues?assignee=3). A full page reload of /bench/bench-repo/issues/4 confirmed persistence: the sidebar assignee line reads "bench-assignee
(Bench Assignee)" and the combo's hidden value is "3". Whole task done and verified. Note: Escape does not dismiss this dropdown; only an outside click committed the change.
